::: {.cell}

:::


The data are APSIM simulations of wheat at Narrabri (New South Wales): 199 genotypes in 31 seasons (1983 to 2013), daily from 15 days after sowing to maturity. Weather is common to all genotypes within a season and is stored in a separate table.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
wx   <- read.csv("data/narrabri_weather.csv")
traj <- read.csv("data/narrabri_biomass.csv.gz")
head(wx, 3)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

1 1983  15 247.50 11.191 0.7966  12
2 1983  16 256.75 11.180 0.7909  11
3 1983  17 267.50 11.169 0.7838  13
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
head(traj, 3)
```

```

1     g001 1983  15  0.0164 0.039

```


:::
:::


| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `das` | days after sowing |
| `TT` | accumulated thermal time since sowing (°C d) |
| `DL` | day length (h) |
| `RAW` | relative available soil water (0 to 1) |
| `RAD` | solar radiation (MJ m⁻² d⁻¹) |
| `biomass` | above-ground dry matter (t ha⁻¹) |
| `lai` | leaf area index (m² m⁻²) |

## Biomass

Each line is one genotype. The four seasons were chosen to span the range of weather.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
seasons <- traj[traj$year %in% c(1984, 1990, 1998, 2008), ]
ggplot(seasons, aes(das, biomass, group = genotype)) +
  geom_line(colour = dgxe[["blue"]], linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.25) +
  facet_wrap(~year, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "days after sowing", y = "biomass (t/ha)") +
  theme_dgxe()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](02-data_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){width=1036.8}
:::
:::


## Weather

Each grey line is one season; the blue line is the mean over seasons.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
drivers <- c("TT", "DL", "RAW", "RAD")
w <- data.frame(year = wx$year, das = wx$das,
                driver = factor(rep(drivers, each = nrow(wx)), drivers),
                value = unlist(wx[drivers]))
mean_path <- aggregate(value ~ driver + das, w, mean)

ggplot(w, aes(das, value)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = year), colour = dgxe[["grey"]],
            linewidth = 0.25, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(data = mean_path, colour = dgxe[["blue"]], linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~driver, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "days after sowing", y = NULL) +
  theme_dgxe()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](02-data_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){width=1036.8}
:::
:::


Trajectories end on different days, since genotypes mature at different times. The end of each trajectory is tracked in step 3.
